from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen-4/play/users/u065/system/state/workspace/programs/task-21b601d8.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Mark the background continuation after a partial horizontal bar as 1.
    for row in grid:
        if row and row[0] != bg:
            first_bg = next((i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v == bg), w)
            if 0 < first_bg < w and all(v == bg for v in row[first_bg:]):
                for c in range(first_bg, w):
                    out[grid.index(row)][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
